questions.question: Redis là gì và tại sao được dùng như cache?

options.B: Redis: in-memory key-value store, sub-millisecond latency, rich data structures, persistence options — ideal cho caching, sessions, queues

questions.explanation: Redis (Remote Dictionary Server): in-memory, single-threaded (fast), sub-millisecond operations. Data structures: String, Hash, List, Set, Sorted Set, Stream, HyperLogLog. Persistence: RDB (snapshot), AOF (append-only file), hybrid. Use cases: caching (hot data), sessions, rate limiting, pub/sub, leaderboards, job queues (Bull/BullMQ). Cluster: horizontal scaling, 16384 hash slots. Sentinel: HA monitoring. Redis Stack: JSON, Search, Time Series, Bloom filter. 80%+ Vietnamese companies dùng Redis cho caching.

questions.question: Redis data types — String, Hash, List, Set, Sorted Set?

options.B: String: text/number/binary. Hash: object fields. List: ordered linked list. Set: unique unordered. Sorted Set: unique with score, ordered by score
options.C: Hash là cách dùng duy nhất

questions.explanation: String: SET/GET/INCR/DECR/APPEND/STRLEN. Hữu ích: counter, cached JSON, session token. Hash: HSET/HGET/HGETALL/HMSET. Hữu ích: user object fields. List: LPUSH/RPUSH/LPOP/RPOP/LRANGE/LLEN. Hữu ích: message queue, activity feed. Set: SADD/SMEMBERS/SISMEMBER/SINTER/SUNION. Hữu ích: unique visitors, tags, social graph. Sorted Set: ZADD/ZRANGE/ZRANGEBYSCORE/ZRANK. Hữu ích: leaderboard, delayed queue. TTL: EXPIRE key seconds, TTL key.

questions.question: Cache-aside pattern với Redis?

options.A: Redis tự cập nhật cache khi DB thay đổi
options.B: App check Redis → cache miss → query DB → store in Redis với TTL → return. Cache hit: return Redis data
options.C: Write to Redis chỉ, không cần DB

questions.explanation: Cache-aside (Lazy Loading): (1) Check Redis: GET user:123. (2) Cache HIT → return data. (3) Cache MISS → SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=123. (4) Store: SET user:123 JSON TTL 3600. (5) Return data. Advantages: only cache what's requested, cache failure không break app. Disadvantages: cache miss = slow (3 ops), stale data nếu TTL dài. Write strategies: Write-through (write Redis + DB đồng thời), Write-behind (write Redis, async write DB). Cache stampede: nhiều requests cùng miss → DB overload. Fix: mutex lock, probabilistic early expiry.

questions.question: Redis Pub/Sub và Streams — khác nhau thế nào?

options.B: Pub/Sub: fire-and-forget, no persistence, subscriber phải online. Streams (5.0+): persistent log, consumer groups, message acknowledgment — như Kafka lightweight

questions.explanation: Pub/Sub: PUBLISH channel message, SUBSCRIBE channel. Messages lost nếu subscriber offline. Use: real-time notifications, simple messaging. Streams: XADD stream_key * field value. XREAD: consume messages. Consumer groups: XGROUP CREATE, XREADGROUP — multiple consumers, track processed. XACK: acknowledge processing. Persistent: survives Redis restart (với AOF). Use: task queues, event sourcing, activity feeds. BullMQ (Node.js): Streams-based job queue. Recommendation: dùng Streams cho production queues, Pub/Sub cho simple fanout.

questions.question: Redis persistence — RDB vs AOF?

options.B: RDB: periodic snapshot (BGSAVE), compact, faster restart, data loss between snapshots. AOF: log every write, durable, slower restart, larger file. Hybrid: RDB + AOF
options.D: Persistence làm Redis chậm đáng kể

questions.explanation: RDB (Redis Database): fork → BGSAVE → write snapshot file (dump.rdb). Config: save 900 1 (snapshot nếu 1 key đổi trong 900s). Tradeoff: data loss nếu crash giữa 2 snapshots. AOF (Append-Only File): log every write command. fsync options: always (safe, slow), everysec (1s data loss, balanced), no (OS decide). AOF rewrite: compact file periodically. Hybrid mode (Redis 4+): RDB snapshot + AOF tail — best of both. Production recommendation: hybrid với fsync everysec.

questions.question: Implement rate limiting với Redis cho API?

options.A: Rate limiting chỉ cần ở nginx
options.B: Token bucket hoặc sliding window: INCR key với EXPIRE, hoặc sorted set với timestamps, hoặc Redis Cell module
options.C: Database lock là cách duy nhất

questions.explanation: Fixed window (đơn giản): INCR rate:user:123:2024-01-15-14. EXPIRE rate:... 60. If count > 100: reject. Nhược: boundary burst. Sliding window với Sorted Set: ZADD rate:user:123 timestamp timestamp. ZREMRANGEBYSCORE rate:... 0 (now-60000). ZCARD rate:... → if > 100: reject. EXPIRE rate:... 60. Atomic Lua script: đảm bảo race condition free. Redis Cell (module): cl.throttle key max_burst count_per_period period — built-in token bucket. express-rate-limit với Redis store cho Node.js.

questions.question: Redis memory usage cao — keys không expire. Debug và fix?

options.B: redis-cli --bigkeys, INFO memory, DEBUG OBJECT để check encoding, SCAN để find keyspace patterns, set maxmemory và eviction policy

questions.explanation: Debug: (1) INFO memory: used_memory, mem_fragmentation_ratio. (2) redis-cli --bigkeys: find largest keys. (3) MEMORY USAGE key: bytes of specific key. (4) MEMORY DOCTOR: advice. (5) redis-cli --hotkeys: most accessed. Fix: (1) maxmemory 2gb + maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru (evict LRU khi đầy). (2) Enforce TTL: mọi cache key phải có TTL. (3) Compact encoding: set hash-max-listpack-entries 128 (small hashes dùng efficient encoding). (4) OBJECT ENCODING key: ziplist/listpack vs hashtable. (5) SCAN 0 MATCH 'pattern*' COUNT 100: iterate keys không block. KEYS '*' KHÔNG dùng production (block Redis).

questions.question: Redis Cluster setup và consistent hashing?

options.A: Single Redis là đủ cho mọi scale
options.B: Redis Cluster: 16384 hash slots phân chia giữa masters. CLUSTER KEYSLOT để tính slot. Hash tags {user} để collocate keys. Read từ replicas

questions.explanation: Redis Cluster: tối thiểu 3 masters + 3 replicas. 16384 hash slots: CRC16(key) % 16384 → determine shard. Minimum: each master has its own replica. Hash tags: {user}:profile và {user}:sessions → same slot (multi-key operations). Cross-slot operations: không support MGET với keys khác slot. CLUSTER INFO: cluster state. CLUSTER NODES: topology. Scale: thêm node → CLUSTER REBALANCE. Failure: nếu master down → replica promoted. Setup: redis-cli --cluster create host1:6379 host2:6379 ... --cluster-replicas 1. Sentinel: HA cho single master (không phải sharding).
